description: Patronus AI is a commercial evaluation and security platform with experiments, judge models, hallucination and RAG evaluators, red teaming, monitoring, and enterprise controls.

name: Galileo
description: Galileo is a commercial AI evaluation and observability platform with RAG quality metrics, retrieval and generation diagnostics, experiments, tracing, monitoring, and guardrails.

name: LangSmith
description: LangSmith is LangChain's commercial platform for tracing, datasets, offline and online evaluation, annotation, prompt management, experiments, and production monitoring across framework choices.

name: Opik
description: Opik is an open-source evaluation and observability platform from Comet with tracing, datasets, experiments, LLM judges, RAG metrics, prompt management, and a hosted service.

name: Evidently
description: Evidently is an open-source evaluation and monitoring library with test suites, reports, retrieval and generation descriptors, datasets, tracing integrations, and a commercial cloud.

name: BEIR
description: BEIR is a heterogeneous zero-shot information-retrieval benchmark spanning 18 datasets and multiple domains, with standardized loaders, retrieval baselines, and evaluation metrics.

name: MTEB
description: MTEB is a large multilingual benchmark and evaluation package for text embeddings across retrieval, reranking, classification, clustering, semantic similarity, and related tasks.

name: CRAG
description: CRAG is Meta's Comprehensive RAG Benchmark with thousands of questions, temporal and long-tail facts, mock web and knowledge-graph APIs, and end-to-end scoring.

name: BRIGHT
description: BRIGHT is a benchmark for reasoning-intensive retrieval across technical and everyday domains where identifying relevant documents requires substantial query reasoning.

name: RAGBench
description: RAGBench is a large explainable RAG dataset across multiple industry domains with retrieved contexts, responses, labels, and the associated TRACe evaluation framework.

name: MTRAG
description: MTRAG is IBM's human-generated benchmark for evaluating multi-turn retrieval-augmented generation across domains, conversation histories, retrieval, and grounded responses.

name: MIRACL
description: MIRACL is a multilingual information-retrieval benchmark with relevance judgments for queries and Wikipedia passages across 18 languages.

name: LoTTE
description: LoTTE is a long-tail topic-stratified retrieval benchmark with search and forum queries across five domains and pooled relevance judgments.

name: KILT
description: KILT is Meta's benchmark that grounds multiple knowledge-intensive language tasks in a shared Wikipedia snapshot and scores both retrieval provenance and task output.

name: MS MARCO
description: MS MARCO is Microsoft's large-scale passage and document ranking benchmark derived from real search queries with relevance labels and public leaderboard tasks.

name: Natural Questions
description: Natural Questions is Google's question-answering dataset of real search queries paired with Wikipedia pages and annotated long and short answers.

name: HotpotQA
description: HotpotQA is a multi-hop question-answering benchmark with supporting-fact annotations that tests retrieval and reasoning across multiple Wikipedia passages.

name: ViDoRe
description: ViDoRe is a benchmark and evaluation toolkit for visual document retrieval across page images, varied document domains, and multilingual queries.

name: RAGTruth
description: RAGTruth is a corpus of RAG responses with word-level hallucination annotations across question answering, data-to-text generation, and summarization.

name: RGB
description: RGB is a benchmark for RAG robustness across noise tolerance, negative rejection, information integration, and counterfactual conflict.

name: Langfuse
description: Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform with self-hosting and cloud options for traces, sessions, prompt management, datasets, evaluations, metrics, and cost analysis.

name: Helicone
description: Helicone is an open-source AI gateway and observability platform with request logging, sessions, caching, routing, rate limits, experiments, evaluations, and a hosted service.

name: OpenLLMetry
description: OpenLLMetry is an OpenTelemetry-based set of instrumentations for capturing model, vector-database, framework, and agent spans and exporting them to compatible backends.

name: OpenInference
description: OpenInference is an open specification and instrumentation collection for representing LLM, retrieval, reranking, embedding, tool, and agent operations as OpenTelemetry traces.

name: OpenLIT
description: OpenLIT is an OpenTelemetry-native AI engineering platform with tracing, metrics, prompt management, evaluations, guardrails, cost tracking, and self-hosted or cloud deployment.

name: LangWatch
description: LangWatch is an open-source platform with hosted options for LLM traces, evaluations, dashboards, prompt optimization, and scenario-based agent simulation.

name: Portkey
description: Portkey is an open-source AI gateway paired with a commercial control plane for routing, fallbacks, caching, budgets, observability, guardrails, and provider access policies.

name: Datadog LLM Observability
description: Datadog LLM Observability is a commercial tracing and monitoring product for LLM and RAG applications with retrieval spans, quality signals, security scanning, cost, and latency analysis.

name: LLM Guard
description: LLM Guard is an open-source input and output scanning library for prompt injection, secrets, PII, toxicity, malicious URLs, relevance, factual consistency, and other risks.

name: NeMo Guardrails
description: NeMo Guardrails is NVIDIA's open-source toolkit for programmable dialog, retrieval, execution, and safety rails, including topical controls and groundedness checks.

name: Guardrails AI
description: Guardrails AI is an open-source validation framework with a hosted platform and validator hub for structured outputs, content checks, PII, provenance, and policy enforcement.

name: Lakera Guard
description: Lakera Guard is a commercial API for detecting prompt injection, jailbreaks, harmful content, and sensitive information in AI application inputs and outputs.

name: garak
description: garak is NVIDIA's open-source generative-AI vulnerability scanner with probes and detectors for prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination, toxicity, jailbreaks, and other failure modes.

name: Canopy
description: Canopy was Pinecone's open-source RAG framework and context engine; its GitHub repository is archived, so new systems should use maintained alternatives or lower-level Pinecone SDKs.

name: Kùzu
description: Kùzu was an embedded property-graph database with Cypher, vector search, and full-text search; its GitHub repository was archived in October 2025.

name: llama-hub legacy repository
description: llama-hub legacy repository was the original home of LlamaIndex data loaders; it was archived in March 2024 after integrations moved to maintained package repositories.
